reviewed_source_state: Reviewed v3 MAC with scrypt-bound verifier, verifierEnc on the wire by default when a pepper is present (OPENSESAME_FEDERATED_PENDING_SEAL_VERIFIER default on; explicit false is rollout-off), and leg-binding for seal/unseal. 2026-11-23 review (#2899, squash 760292b7): federated.ts moved FederatedUpstream, federatedUpstreams, matchUpstreamHint and isTrustedUpstream into the new federated-upstreams.ts and re-exports them; it also re-exports four more existing upstream-logout.ts functions. Compared with the reviewed bytes (760292b7^): matchUpstreamHint, isTrustedUpstream, federatedUpstreams, issuerHost and the shoo.dev branch of describeUpstream are byte-identical. The only behaviour change is that describeUpstream's inline isLoopback became issuer-loopback.ts isLoopbackIssuer, which reads URL.hostname instead of splitting URL.host on ':', so an IPv6 loopback issuer such as http://[::1]:9090 is now labelled id 'mock' (previously its host) on the allowlist display. isTrustedUpstream stays exact membership in trustedUpstreamIssuers. No production caller of these four names exists (only tests), and none is on the pending-cookie, legacy-provenance, current-trust or verifier-binding paths that FED-I1-I4 model, so the model needs no change. federated-upstreams.ts joins the covered sources (here, check-drift.mjs, proof-registry.json, proof-requirements.json and the pinned suite minimum) and federated.ts is re-pinned; issuer-loopback.ts is a display/browser-capability helper shared with the uncovered registry.ts and stays outside this suite. 2026-11-23 review (#2899, squash 760292b7) of routes/interactions.ts against its reviewed bytes (73e48026): the only change imports joinRefusalStatus from organization-membership.ts and returns its status when the SSO just-in-time join is refused, 503 for membership_withdrawing and 403 otherwise (previously always 403). The refusal still returns before finishLoginInteraction, after the unchanged pending-issuer, trust-source, organization-ID and configured-issuer checks, so no success path is added and FED-I3's ordering of trust checks before account or organization effects is preserved; the status code is not modeled.
